fields.name: whatsapp
fields.label: WhatsApp number
fields.helpText: Include your country code. We’ll use this to coordinate your presentation.

fields.name: project
fields.label: What are you building?
fields.helpText: Tell us what your project does, your tech stack and architecture, and a challenge you’d like to discuss.

fields.name: theme
fields.label: Which theme fits your project best?
fields.helpText: Name the theme or technical topic that suits your project. If you’re unsure, write ‘Help me choose’.

fields.name: consent
fields.label: I agree to the presentation guidelines below and may be contacted about presenting.
fields.helpText:
• You have 15 minutes to present, followed by 15 minutes of technical Q&A on your tech stack and architecture.

• There is no actual roasting. This is a constructive technical conversation among the community, with the host facilitating questions.

• You don’t need every answer. You can say ‘I don’t know’, ask for technical help, and we’ll open it to the floor. This is a learning opportunity for you and the audience.

• Focus on technical sharing, not sales. A small call to action is fine; it should not be the whole presentation.

• Please arrive around 6:30 pm so we can connect your laptop to the screen.

settings.confirmationMessage: Thanks for putting yourself forward! We’ll contact you on WhatsApp to discuss your project, theme fit and a possible slot. This is an expression of interest, not a confirmed presentation slot.
